label: C* for caused movers on the prima via: meaning, unified derivation, retained-state test
summary: Owner request to tackle C* (a caused mover is itself being moved, whenever it moves, in a respect relevant to that moving), the contested load of the absolute First-Way result d337ab29 identified by lane A (PR #1768, accepted after challenge, unmerged; cited as in-flight). Baseline main df4909cb025d2e53fee6071a32defe9cf2721284. Read: the Lean bodies of 1e47e6db, 96da1d33, b3573a61, 226c38f6, f03798ba, d791628f, 0628359b, 777646a5, 8a22ae75 and 446e3f2a; DEF c9798301, 55a974ea, 4a101a4c, c195d490, 04cbb76b, 45595dac, 9f874532, a7904c82 and 211a6432; DISAMB CAUSE, PER-SE-LINK, MOTION and POTENCY; docs/notes/borrowed-exercise-741.md. Materialized and read pinned Physics III.2 (5e66eaa9), III.3 (d0e5f8bf), V.2 opening (93c5b826), ST I q.105 a.5 (915df403), q.25 a.1 (09369215), and in the repair round ST I q.104 a.1 (f74e1b94) and SCG I.13 (92bd0343); every use is an analyst reading and no claim was added. Findings. (1) Meaning: the route needs sense (ii), present lending (R2: y is being moved in r' by some z and moves x by a power it has through that present being moved, as z's instrument, the sense of the existing support 8b58de76 through 962a9ed3 and 7b8b589c); reaction from the patient is not lending. (i) any change admits the digesting man; (iii) originating dependence gives per accidens series. A counterfactual test does not separate reaction from lending, since under conservation laws reaction is counterfactually necessary for action; R1 (modulating) and any counterfactual reading that counts reaction defeat themselves, because with 96da1d33 and 226c38f6 they are inconsistent with any reciprocal pair. The standing-power rival targets exactly (ii)/R2 and must concede (i), since a mover moved in no respect would satisfy the absolute conclusion's Lean form. (2) Unification: new open statements 631e014f (non-God-indexed f03798ba), the bridge 7bf380c6 (operation respect is relevant) and e3afc8a3 (b3573a61 for caused movers); 631e014f, d791628f, 0628359b and 7bf380c6 give e3afc8a3 with no axioms, and with the input that an uncaused mover is moved in no respect (proposed to be supplied by the 2026-11-17 esse-composition inputs) give b3573a61 classically; scratch-checked, not registered. Without the bridge they give only sense (i), which is all 777646a5 and the first-being bridge 74eb9113 use. Preflight (truth semantics, PR #1767 binary): the CAUSE guard needs a sense bridge or a per-sense split before registration (CAUSE_1/CAUSE_2); the POTENCY_1/POTENCY_3 failure was removed by dropping the DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE link from 631e014f; formal follow-up. (3) Test: the teacher and fire have present instrumental structure through parts and do not test C*. Retained-state movers (a hot iron heating wood while cooling; a projectile decelerated by its target) are moved only by the patient's reaction, which is counterfactually tied to the action but lends no power; nothing else presently moves them and their power rests on a retained state. Aquinas's own texts describe the class: q.104 a.1 co. (heated water retains heat after the fire's action ceases) and SCG I.13 [8] (bodies moved through nature are moved by the generating cause and the remover of impediments, an originating cause). Physics III.2 202a3-7 supports b3573a61's antecedent, not relevance. Under POTENCY_1 the operation form 631e014f/f03798ba is false of a mover already in act in its operation respects (scratch control); DISAMB-POTENCY assigns a power retained during exercise to capacity, not to adopted potency. Thomist replies: concurrence (q.105 a.5) is God-indexed and not MOTION_1 under POTENCY_1; operation as a distinct second act (q.25 a.1 ad 2-3) and conservation are closed by Aquinas's own texts, q.104 a.1 ad 4 (conservation is without motion), q.104 a.1 co. and SCG I.13 [10] (motion taken strictly, not Plato's any operation), and a broad reading would need a sense passage from POTENCY_1 to DEF-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY or POTENCY_3, the latter refuting the no-self-motion step; virtus impressa is originating; relabelling reaction as relevant is self-defeating; celestial lending (SCG I.13 [12]-[13], [31]) is non-God-indexed and R2 in form but fails physically. Rival's independent justification: the physical cases, Physics III.3 202a13-21 and 202a25-b8, V.2 225b10-16. Result: a kept counterexample class to universal C* on R2, proposed as a claimed defeat. (4) New: 1e47e6db with 226c38f6 entails that no two distinct beings move each other while each is moved (scratch, no axioms); with the observation premise 4f6ac439 the bundle is inconsistent; 96da1d33 with the regress and a reciprocal pair has a two-element model when the pair's relevance is false, as on the lending reading. The same pattern applies to 8a22ae75 (not checked). Repair: a series- or respect-indexed per se link, after which the absolute conclusion again needs C*; the reciprocity result requires repairing the encoding and is not a second count against the route. (5) Scope: instrument C* is well supported and onset C* moderate, but neither suffices; restricting to caused movers gains nothing. A sustaining series (removal test of DEF 4a101a4c) answers the counterexample class at matching scope but yields only a sibling first mediate mover unmoved in every respect, needing a mediate-moving sense and contested by existential inertia. Judgment: universal C* weak (positive warrant: q.2 a.3 claim 095dc31a and SCG I.13 [15], presentations of the same assumption; weak rather than contested because MOTION_1 is the broad sense and what excludes conservation and steady exercise is POTENCY_1's not-in-act clause); absolute First-Way conclusion c1b68c21 through its three GOD_4 consumers ed7c588a, beec1dc1 and fd1f7e75 weak (proposed revision of PR #1768's moderate grade); relative conclusion e05d2976 unaffected; other GOD_4 arguments (quarta via 678ff65f and 661ce61d, De ente 2bd7ee56, esse-root 3367bf93 and fc46b7f9) do not use c1b68c21, so C* is not load-bearing for God's existence on the case as a whole. Follow-up 2026-11-19 (attempt 092c7439, note section 9): the section 8 formal tests were registered as results 739d177c (unified derivation, with 631e014f declared as the CAUSE_2 to CAUSE_1 sense bridge), 9a15e352 (extension to b3573a61 with the new open a1df8f1a) and 0dc12783 (reciprocity exclusion); the holding (MOTION_3) reading of being moved was tested as a sibling route. Curation (#2103, 2026-11-27, lane E batch 7): passage (2') built from 5eb16c61 with open premises 89f0d0d5 and f856b295 and 6e2176cd (result 544bc129, conclusion de1f6c17); bridge (3) as two open MOTION_3 to MOTION_1 sense bridges ac93d55a and e2f44380 carries it to c1b68c21 (result 2b40780f); 6fdb45c3 feeds cf7940a7 (result 00761dc8); leaning cards 5469677e recorded as attacking 685933c7. docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md section 11.
blocker: Universal C* on its fixed meaning (present lending, R2) has a kept counterexample class: retained-state movers (a hot iron heating wood while cooling; a projectile decelerated by its target), moved only by the patient's reaction, which lends no power. Its operation-route derivation (631e014f or f03798ba with d791628f, 0628359b and the bridge 7bf380c6) fails under adopted POTENCY_1 for steady exercise, and its non-God-indexed support is missing: concurrence is God-indexed, conservation is not MOTION_1 (q.104 a.1 ad 4), and celestial lending fails physically. Separately, the absolute route's premise pair 1e47e6db and 226c38f6 is inconsistent with reciprocal moving (4f6ac439), which requires an encoding repair. Next test: compare present conservation of caused beings (the removal test of DEF 4a101a4c) with existential inertia for retained-state movers, and decide whether a faithful mediate-moving sense lets the terminus of a sustaining series count as first mover of the motion. Formal follow-ups: resolve the CAUSE_1/CAUSE_2 preflight failure of the unified derivation's domain guard; certify the unified derivation, the reciprocity inconsistency and its secunda-via analogue, the steady-exercise and R1 controls and the two-element model; split RelevantTo into lending and modulating senses; draft a series-indexed per se link.

current_assessment.scope: The commitment C* on the prima via route to GOD_4 exists (8626f8a5, argument ed7c588a): the scope bridge b3573a61, its operation-route derivation (f03798ba, its non-God-indexed restatement 631e014f, d791628f and the bridge 7bf380c6), its caused-mover form e3afc8a3, and the reciprocity observation premise 4f6ac439 that bears on the absolute route's premise pair 1e47e6db and 226c38f6. 8a22ae75 is named as the secunda-via analogue and not reassessed; 1e47e6db, 226c38f6 and d337ab29 are discussed as consumers, not regraded beyond the stated proposal.
current_assessment.assessment: Fixed meaning: C* must be present lending (sense (ii), relevance R2: moved by some z and moving by a power had through that present being moved, as in 962a9ed3); reaction from the patient is not lending, and a counterfactual test cannot separate them. The standing-power rival targets exactly this and concedes that its movers change in some respect. 631e014f, d791628f, 0628359b and 7bf380c6 jointly give e3afc8a3 (scratch-checked; the preflight requires a CAUSE_1/CAUSE_2 bridge or split before registration), so C* is one commitment; without 7bf380c6 they give only the some-respect content that 777646a5 and 74eb9113 use. Universal C* (e3afc8a3, b3573a61) and its operation route are open, blocked by a kept counterexample class of retained-state movers (hot iron, projectile), moved only by the patient's reaction; Aquinas's own q.104 a.1 and SCG I.13 [8] describe the class. Under adopted POTENCY_1 the operation form is false of steady exercise. The Thomist replies are God-indexed (concurrence), closed by Aquinas's own texts (operation as second act, conservation: q.104 a.1 ad 4, SCG I.13 [10]), originating (virtus impressa), self-defeating (reaction as relevant) or physically refuted (celestial lending). Positive warrant: q.2 a.3 (095dc31a) and SCG I.13 [15], presentations of the same assumption. Provisional grade: weak rather than contested, because MOTION_1 is the broad sense and what excludes conservation and steady exercise is POTENCY_1's not-in-act clause; a proposed claimed defeat. Restricted C* for instruments and driven movers is well supported and onset C* moderate; neither suffices. 4f6ac439 makes 1e47e6db with 226c38f6 inconsistent (scratch-checked); this requires repairing the encoding, every repair needs C*, and it is not a second count. The absolute conclusion c1b68c21, through ed7c588a, beec1dc1 and fd1f7e75, is weakly supported (proposed revision of the in-flight moderate grade of PR #1768); the relative conclusion e05d2976 is unaffected; the quarta via, De ente and esse-root GOD_4 arguments do not use c1b68c21. A sustaining-series reading answers the counterexample class at matching scope but yields only a sibling first mediate mover. Nothing is established, defeated or closed.
